description: This file implements the CallService class, which manages invoking external services within the OFBiz minilang framework. It handles service invocation, error processing, and mapping results to various contexts such as request, session, or environment variables. The class is designed to facilitate dynamic service calls specified in XML configuration elements, supporting complex workflows.

classes.name: CallService
classes.description: Handles dynamic invocation of services within the minilang framework, including managing input/output mappings, error handling, and result processing.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the service call, processes results, manages error messages, and updates context variables based on success or failure.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Collects and registers service name information for artifact analysis.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the CallService instance, primarily for debugging.

inner_classes.name: CallServiceFactory
inner_classes.description: Factory class for creating CallService instances from XML elements.

inner_classes.name: ResultToField
inner_classes.description: Handles mapping of service result fields to environment variables.

inner_classes.name: ResultToRequest
inner_classes.description: Maps service result fields to HTTP request attributes.

inner_classes.name: ResultToResult
inner_classes.description: Transfers data from service results to other service result maps.

inner_classes.name: ResultToSession
inner_classes.description: Stores service result fields into user session attributes.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Main execution method that invokes a service, processes the result, handles errors, and updates contextual data accordingly.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Gathers and adds the service name to the artifact info context.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a descriptive string output for debugging.
